newsitem.title: FRANCE: Air Liquide seeks double-digit oper profit rise.
newsitem.headline: Air Liquide seeks double-digit oper profit rise.

text.p: Chemicals company Air Liquide said on Thursday its first-quarter profit was above the corresponding 1996 level.
It also said Chairman Alain Joly targetted double-digit growth in operating profit this year at the shareholders' meeting.

"Given the start of contracts signed in 1995 and 1996 and the acceleration of cost-reduction programmes, the group's objective for the full year is double-digit growth in operating profit barring a sharp deterioration in the economic environment," Air Liquide said in a statement.
It said its first-quarter profit showed a "sharp improvement" but gave no figures.
